premises.text: African graduates face outdated curricula and a wide gap to rising global tech job opportunities
premises.evidence_span: The Nigerian education system did not prepare me for today's job market. I graduated from school and began applying for jobs, right? But somehow, the opportunities I could access right now were from the 1950s

premises.text: One-year program of African-made innovative content: nine months structured learning/soft skills/mentorship plus three months internship
premises.evidence_span: Through our one-year learning program, you gain access to nine months of structured learning, soft skill training, mentorship, and three months of internship

premises.text: Schools expand to market-needed technical tracks (engineering launched; product and data planned)
premises.evidence_span: In October 2021, we launched the School of Engineering. And later this year, we plan on launching School of Products, School of Data, anything that the market needs

premises.text: Lower entry barrier than costly bootcamps: SSE access and $20 application with $50–$500 tuition or free ISA until employed
premises.evidence_span: Compared to other coding boot camps and online nano degrees, which cost a minimum of $1,000, All School Africa is a sure path, cost-effective way towards accessing online education within a period of one year

premises.text: Support structure continues from coding start through career progression with industry mentorship
premises.evidence_span: from the moment you join the old school program, from the day you start coding to the day you become a CTO, we are supporting you through a support structure

premises.text: Expand beyond Anglophone into Francophone and other African markets
premises.evidence_span: tap into the Francophone market, which remains untapped. All opportunities are pointing towards Anglophone. We want to go into other African countries

domains.name: Inclusive tech learning program and career support

value.text: Africans gain accessible technical skills to compete for global tech opportunities
value.evidence_span: ensure that every African has access to such opportunities, such that they can compete on a global scale
